title: The Listening Grove · 617 Works
dek: A meditative MidJourney archive for Tezos: 617 works, 49 living pieces, synthesized bells and gongs.
body:
The Listening Grove is a full-screen art instrument built from two preserved MidJourney sessions and 49 featured Southern California tree studies. Move through the archive to bend the image field, ring synthesized bells and gongs, or enter the 49-work Living sequence.

Each work is prepared as a five-edition, 10-tez collection preview. Source hashes, dimensions, MidJourney job metadata, and derivative hashes are preserved in the catalog. Wallet connection can be tested with Kukai, but no mint or tez operation is active.
